blocks.text: What makes a fashion designer? This question is often posed to anyone in the industry who dared to pick up needle and thread. But for Ia Coca, the secret to lasting success in this cutthroat industry isn’t skill with fabric shears or a penchant for pattern but an ear—an ear for what clients really want. “I like to offer what expertise I can, an adjustment here or a particular cut to flatter their figure, but first and foremost I listen to my clients and add my touch later.
